title: Tour: Ask AI
blurb: Your built-in assistant. Ask it questions or get it to do CRM jobs for you.

steps.title: Open Ask AI
steps.body: Click **Ask AI** in the left menu. This opens the assistant full screen.

steps.title: Your Luubu assistant
steps.body: Ask AI is a chat assistant that knows your Luubu account. Type what you want in plain English, like you would text a staff member. It can look things up, write copy, and make changes for you.

steps.title: Type your request here
steps.body: Use the message box at the bottom. Be specific: who, what and when. For example: "Show me contacts tagged roofing who haven't been contacted in 30 days."
steps.tip: Prefer talking? Click the microphone icon to speak your request.

steps.title: You stay in control
steps.body: Before Ask AI creates, changes or deletes anything, it shows you what it plans to do and waits for you to confirm. Read it, then approve or cancel.

steps.title: Start fresh
steps.body: Click **New Chat** when you switch to a different job. Your past chats are kept in the history list so you can pick up where you left off.

steps.title: What next
steps.body: Next: try **See what Ask AI can do** from the Guide for a list of handy things to ask.
